name_zh: 桑地诺/尼加拉瓜/游击/反美/海军/英雄/奥古斯托/拉斯/塞戈维亚
description_zh: 奥古斯托·桑地诺 (1895-1934) 尼加拉瓜革命领导人，领导反美游击战争，被誉为 "民族英雄", 对拉美反美斗争和民族解放产生深远影响，被誉为 "拉美解放者", 桑地诺主义成为拉美反美斗争象征。
description_en: Augusto Sandino (1895-1934) Nicaraguan revolutionary leader, led anti-American guerrilla warfare, known as "national hero", had profound impact on Latin American anti-American struggle and national liberation, known as "Latin American liberator", Sandinism became Latin American anti-American struggle symbol.
reason_zh: 桑地诺代表拉美革命者如何通过反美游击战争实现国家解放，如何建立民族解放运动，以及如何成为拉美反美斗争和民族解放运动象征，体现了拉美反美斗争精神。
reason_en: Sandino represents how Latin American revolutionaries achieve national liberation through anti-American guerrilla warfare, establish national liberation movement, and become symbol of Latin American anti-American struggle and national liberation, embodies Latin American anti-American struggle spirit.

评估反美斗争/民族解放/尼加拉瓜经济
总结解放遗产/尼加拉瓜现代国家/桑地诺主义
steps_en: Study Sandino early peasant career/anti-colonial consciousness formation/anti-American idea
Analyze 1927 establishment of guerrilla force/anti-American struggle/national liberation
Explore anti-American guerrilla warfare/International relations/Revolutionary struggle
expected_zh: 理解拉美革命者如何通过反美游击战争实现国家解放，如何建立民族解放运动，以及如何成为拉美反美斗争和民族解放运动象征。
expected_en: Understand how Latin American revolutionaries achieve national liberation through anti-American guerrilla warfare, establish national liberation movement, and become symbol of Latin American anti-American struggle and national liberation.
